name: TheSportsDB
tagline: Free multi-sport database API for teams, events, players, and league data with media assets
description: TheSportsDB provides a free multi-sport REST API covering football, basketball, baseball, hockey, motorsport, and more. Developers can look up teams, leagues, fixtures/events, players, and standings, and often pull team badges and other media. It is commonly used in hobby apps, sports dashboards, and learning projects. Free access uses a shared demo key with limited data; paid plans unlock higher limits and fuller datasets. Authentication is via API key in the URL path.

auth.details: API key in the URL path as /api/v1/json/{API_KEY}/... Free demo key is 123. Paid keys from site membership.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free demo key 123 with limited data and rate limits; paid Premium plans for higher limits and full access (exact free quotas not clearly published on main API page)
pricing.paid_plans: Premium membership tiers available via thesportsdb.com (check site for current pricing)

rate_limits: not published in detail on main docs; free demo key is rate-limited
use_cases: search for a sports team by name and get badge/logo URL
look up upcoming or past events/fixtures for a team or league
fetch player details and career metadata by name
list leagues or teams in a sport for a sports directory app
get league table/standings for a competition
